ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution; approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark grey) central pixels and 35% high-intensity (white/off-white) peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity region centered at the peduncle-fluke junction extending outward to 70% of the lobe width. High-intensity fields occur on distal lateral lobes, containing dense clusters of low-intensity speckling. A distinct high-contrast vertical linear feature is present on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated angle approximately 50 degrees with a depth extending 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel-amplitude variations of up to 15 pixels; characterized by irregular, sharp peaks and shallow valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory originating from the median notch, transitioning to a distinct posterior sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, dark circular pixel groupings located at the far lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical dark line on the right lobe; multiple fine-scale diagonal pixel disruptions (scratches) visible across the high-intensity fields of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular indentation or missing segment on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 15% inward from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-brown high-intensity patch on the anterior-lateral edge of the left lobe, distinct from the primary white pigmentation.
